name: agent-docs
description: Scaffolds AGENTS.md with a project overview and documentation index when missing; detailed docs are created on demand.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold a progressive-disclosure agent doc entry point in any project.
interface.longDescription: On SessionStart, checks the project root for AGENTS.md and, when missing, creates only AGENTS.md with a project overview, documentation index, and rules. No docs/ directory or docs/*.md files are pre-created. Existing AGENTS.md files are preserved. The hook is idempotent and injects a short [project-init] note instead of dumping the repository into context. Requires bash 3.2+ and POSIX userland; set AGENT_DOCS_DISABLE=1 to opt out.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold the agent doc entry point for this project.
Set up AGENTS.md with a project overview and documentation index here.
